key.name: folder-preview-enabled
key.summary: Show previews on folder icons

key.name: folder-preview-layout
key.summary: Preview layout
key.description: grid = up to 4 photos on the folder's front face; stacked = a stack of up to 3 cards.

key.name: folder-preview-cycle
key.summary: Cycle through more photos while hovering

key.name: folder-preview-stack-step
key.summary: Photos per hover step in the stacked layout

key.name: folder-preview-border
key.summary: Draw a border around each photo

key.name: folder-preview-border-colour
key.summary: Photo border colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: folder-preview-border-width
key.summary: Photo border width, in pixels at the 64 × 64 icon size (scaled with the icon)

key.name: folder-preview-shadow
key.summary: Draw a soft shadow under each photo

key.name: folder-preview-rotation
key.summary: Tilt each photo by a random (but stable) angle

key.name: folder-preview-keep-aspect
key.summary: Keep each picture's aspect ratio
key.description: false = pictures fill their section (grid) or card (stacked), cropped.

key.name: folder-preview-depth-effect
key.summary: Depth effect in the stacked layout
key.description: How cards further back look: blur = blurred and darkened; transparency = more transparent; darken = darker; none = only slightly darker. The front card is always fully visible.

key.name: folder-preview-corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of each picture, in pixels at the 64 × 64 icon size (scaled with the icon)

key.name: folder-preview-fade
key.summary: Stacked: fade out the bottom of the stack over this percentage of its height (0 = off)

key.name: folder-preview-view-top-radius
key.summary: Stacked: top corner radius of the area that clips all pictures (px at 64 × 64)
key.description: With both view radii 0 nothing is clipped.

key.name: folder-preview-view-bottom-radius
key.summary: Stacked: bottom corner radius of the area that clips all pictures (px at 64 × 64)

key.name: folder-preview-stack-position
key.summary: Stacked: vertical position of the stack
key.description: top / bottom = 8 px from the icon's top / bottom at 64 × 64; centre = inside the folder.

key.name: folder-preview-stack-padding
key.summary: Stacked: space between the stack and the icon's left and right edges (px at 64 × 64)

key.name: folder-preview-stack-offset
key.summary: Stacked: vertical fine-tuning in pixels at 64 × 64 (positive = down)

key.name: folder-preview-folder-icon
key.summary: Custom folder icon (SVG path) for the stacked layout

key.name: folder-preview-overlay-icon
key.summary: Front overlay (SVG path) drawn over the stack in the stacked layout
key.description: Empty = none. Drawn at the same size and position as the folder icon (the whole icon square).

key.name: sidebar-drives-enabled
key.summary: Enhanced drive rows in the sidebar

key.name: bar-colour-mode
key.summary: Usage bar colour
key.description: accent = the GNOME accent colour; custom = bar-colour; gradient = bar-gradient-start to bar-gradient-end across the filled part.

key.name: bar-colour
key.summary: Custom usage bar colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: bar-gradient-start
key.summary: Gradient start colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: bar-gradient-end
key.summary: Gradient end colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: show-usage-bars
key.summary: Show usage bars on drive rows

key.name: show-size-labels
key.summary: Show the "free of" size labels on drive rows

key.name: eject-slide
key.summary: Slide the eject button in on hover or focus

key.name: details-pane-enabled
key.summary: Offer the details pane (its button in the header bar)

key.name: details-pane-visible
key.summary: Details pane shown (in every window)
key.description: UI state, written when the pane is toggled.

key.name: details-pane-width
key.summary: Details pane width in pixels
key.description: UI state, written when the pane is resized.

key.name: details-pane-position
key.summary: Where the details pane is: right of the folder view or below it

key.name: details-pane-height
key.summary: Details pane height in pixels when at the bottom (UI state)

key.name: details-pane-border
key.summary: Draw a border line between the folder view and the details pane

key.name: details-pane-margin
key.summary: Space around the details pane in pixels (it then floats as a card)

key.name: details-pane-padding
key.summary: Space inside the details pane in pixels

key.name: details-pane-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the details pane in pixels

key.name: details-pane-header-border
key.summary: Draw a line under Files' header bar while the details pane is shown

key.name: details-pane-icon-size
key.summary: Size in pixels of icons in the preview (files, folders, and the front icon of a stack); steps of 16

key.name: details-pane-media-fit
key.summary: shape = the preview box takes the picture's shape; box = a fixed box, the picture flush inside it

key.name: details-pane-title-centered
key.summary: Centre the name and type under the preview

key.name: details-pane-show-icon
key.summary: Show the small icon next to the name

key.name: details-pane-preview-backdrop
key.summary: Fill the preview box behind a picture with a blurred, darker copy of it

key.name: details-pane-preview-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the preview box in pixels

key.name: details-pane-preview-margin
key.summary: Space around the preview box in pixels

key.name: details-pane-stack-depth-effect
key.summary: Several selected: how cards further back look

key.name: details-pane-stack-shadow
key.summary: Several selected: drop shadow under each card

key.name: details-pane-stack-rotation
key.summary: Several selected: tilt the cards behind the front one

key.name: details-pane-stack-keep-aspect
key.summary: Several selected: cards keep their picture's aspect ratio

key.name: details-pane-stack-fade
key.summary: Several selected: bottom fade over this % of the stack (0 = off)

key.name: details-pane-stack-card
key.summary: Several selected: a translucent card behind items without a thumbnail

key.name: details-pane-stack-border
key.summary: Several selected: a border around pictures, videos and PDFs (never around icons or folders)

key.name: details-pane-stack-border-colour
key.summary: Several selected: border colour (#rrggbb)

key.name: details-pane-stack-border-width
key.summary: Several selected: border width in pixels

key.name: details-pane-stack-corner-radius
key.summary: Several selected: corner radius of pictures, videos and PDFs in pixels

key.name: details-pane-stack-spacing
key.summary: Several selected: distance in pixels between the visible tops of neighbouring items

key.name: details-pane-stack-media-square
key.summary: Several selected: pictures, videos and PDFs as squares the size of the icons

key.name: git-enabled
key.summary: Git integration: status bar, columns, Git details in the details pane, Clone Repository…

key.name: git-status-bar
key.summary: Show the Git status bar under the folder view inside repositories

key.name: git-ide
key.summary: Desktop ID of the IDE "Open in IDE" uses ('' = the first one installed)

key.name: folder-icons-enabled
key.summary: Give folders with a rule's name the rule's icon

key.name: folder-icon-rules
key.summary: Folder icon rules: (folder name, icon file path)
key.description: Every folder whose name equals a rule's name exactly gets the rule's icon as its custom icon. The path points at the copy in $XDG_DATA_HOME/nautilus-utils/folder-icons.

key.name: folder-icon-rule-history
key.summary: Names of removed folder icon rules (at most 100)
key.description: Folders with these names are still checked, so icons set by a removed rule can be restored.

key.name: folder-views-enabled
key.summary: Remember the view type and icon size per folder

key.name: folder-views-generation
key.summary: Folder views generation
key.description: Incremented by "Reset All Folder Views"; saved folder views with an older generation are ignored.

key.name: folder-views-default-view
key.summary: View type for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-default-grid-zoom
key.summary: Grid icon size for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-default-list-zoom
key.summary: List icon size for folders without a saved view

key.name: folder-views-defaults-captured
key.summary: Whether the folder views default was copied from Files' settings
key.description: Set once, the first time the feature runs (PLAN.md §10.1.1).
